rows.reasoning: Soliday voted Yea on Roll Call 382 (Mar. 8, 2022) adopting the conference committee report on HB 1296, final passage of a single-subject firearms bill whose enrolled text provides that a person 'is not required to obtain or possess a license or permit from the state to carry a handgun in Indiana,' matching the rung text 'Repeal major gun restrictions and let adults carry a firearm without a permit.'
